arguments.why: MSYS rewrites /refs/heads/main to C:\msys64\refs\heads\main (root-relative POSIX), which is not a git ref
colon rev:path is not POSIX-absolute; still excluded by policy
MSYS special-cases /dev/null to NUL, destroying the Unix-device token
legitimate /c/Users path must convert or the clone silently no-ops
redirect target must convert; an unconverted write truncates the wrong file
